violations.text: The non-food-contact surfaces of hard-to-reach areas of the side of the smoker and back of wok line were observed to have an accumulation of grease food residue. Owner was on site cleaning at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026

The slicer machine was observed with food debris on the blades. Food contact surfaces are to be clean to sight and touch. Per the PIC, unit is to be thoroughly cleaned prior to re-inspection. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

The side(s) of equipment along the cookline was observed to have a buildup of grease under/behind plumbing lines. Equipment is to be thoroughly cleaned and maintained clean to aid in the current pest control program. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

The facility is lacking a mop sink. At least one mop sink or one curbed cleaning facility equipped with a floor drain must be provided and conveniently located for the cleaning of mops or similar wet floor cleaning tools and for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste. Per the owner, mop sink to be installed same day. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

The following areas of the physical facilities are to be cleaned... - A buildup of grease was observed along the wall/floor juncture behind the cookline area. Buildup of grease is to be cleaned and maintained clean to aid in the pest control program. - The floor along the wall next to the Coca-Cola machine was observed with droppings. Droppings are to be cleaned and maintained clean to aid in the monitoring of the pest issue. Per the Owner, cleaning is to be completed same day. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer and grinder) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Items were disassembled for proper cleaning at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by droppings observed on floors under and behind equipment as well as pest control stating 3 mice were caught previously same day. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. The PIC is to ensure the following...' - Continue Increased frequency of Pest control visits until pest control problem is rectified - Follow Pest Control Plan of Action and implement it into daily operation. - Continue to search for and properly close any and all cracks and crevices (inside and outside) allowing for possible rodent access and entry (exterior gaps and openings already began being blocked/filled by the pest technician prior to inspection). - Continue to thoroughly clean and sanitize all shelving affected by rodent activity and thoroughly clean under/behind shelving and equipment - Remove any trapped/dead mice observed (maintain log sheet to keep pest control informed) Pest control technician returned on site at time of inspection. Per the pest technician, service to be completed Saturday 9/12 and Monday 9/14, and twice weekly until pest problem is rectified. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026

The non-food-contact surfaces of the following were observed to have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris... - Slicer machine - Grinder machine - Clean knife magnetic rack - Fryolator sides - Wak cooktop and gas plumbing pipes - Oven Burner top and sides - Refrigeration doors/handles/surfaces - Shelving surfaces Equipment is to be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean and preclude the buildup of soil and debris. (Hood ventilation system and cookline cleaning set for Sunday 9/13/26.) New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026

The following areas of the Physical Facilities were observed in need of thorough cleaning... - The floor and walls behind the cookline area were observed with thick grease/residue/debris - The cookline hood ventilation system observed with a heavy layer of grease - Floors under and behind shelving and refrigeration equipment were observed with droppings and debris - Areas of wall/ceiling junctures were observed with a buildup of cobwebs and dust - Exterior of facility was observed with grease dripping off roof and onto gas plumbing fixtures Physical facilities are to be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean and to aid in the pest control program. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026
